messages.subject: Weighted ANOVA using Encounter Rates
parts:
I wanted to compare population densities of a New Mexico, USA endemic =
lizard species across fourteen study sites. Although I conducted many =
transects at each site, those were pooled in the DISTANCE program to =
yield one density estimate per site. Additionally, my sites differed in =
sampling effort. An ANOVA cannot be performed without replicate density =
estimates from each site. As recommended by Buckland, Rexstad and =
colleagues, I assumed a common detection function across strata and did =
a weighted ANOVA using line-specific encounter rates (ni/li), weighted =
by effort (transect lengths, li).
